dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Welcome, {ten_nhom}! I'm Lumina. There's no ready-made right answer today — only your team's decisions and how the market answers back. Ready?

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: A small tip: before you confirm, try saying the reason for your decision out loud in one sentence. If you can't say it yet, maybe don't press it yet.

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: This round, {ten_nhom}'s revenue {ket_qua}. I won't say which decision was wrong — but look back: what did your team expect that didn't happen?

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Cutting price brings more customers but thins your profit per unit; holding price does the opposite. Neither choice is free — what is your team prioritizing?

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Negative cash flow isn't the end — in real life it costs dearly; here it only costs one round. What would your team change on the next try?

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Before you leave: one decision you're proudest of, one you'd redo. Put them in your reflection — that's today's real score.

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Welcome, founders! Your product already exists — today we let it enter a simulated market and see how much pressure your plan can take.

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: A niche pays more but stays small; the mass market is wide but fiercely contested. The game won't choose for you — it only shows you the price of each path.

dialogues.speaker: lumina
dialogues.text: Where did the final round differ from your original plan? That's the question worth taking home to your real product.
